seed_rule: seed + block width in Mb; chromosomes numeric order; same paired weights for all methods and cases
bootstrap_method: Within each chromosome resample fixed genomic blocks with replacement, same block index multiplicities for every method; sum counts then recompute asymmetric-TP metrics
block_anchor: existing first benchmark BS superlocus anchor, otherwise POS
confidence_interpretation: Pointwise conditional regional percentile intervals; ignores across-person variation and correlations beyond chosen blocks; zero observed errors cannot establish zero true error; no multiple-comparison adjusted superiority claim
